spans.label: root branch memory load
spans.note: Indexed blob oracle must match the EVM mload word at bit-reversed index.

spans.label: prefix products and backward loop
spans.note: Prefixes are products BEFORE the denominator; one modexp; cursor decrements before reading; local subtraction error explicit. Indexed memory/pointer realization not claimed.

spans.label: backward loop memory load
spans.note: Indexed blob oracle must match the exact EVM mload word.

spans.label: backward accumulation and final scaling
spans.note: Ordered sum/inverse-product/root updates and twelve repeated squares represented; correct barycentric evaluation requires a separate interpolation/inversion theorem.

spans.label: point-evaluation memory and staticcall
spans.note: Exact address10/gas50000/input192/output64 and all fields explicit; memory encoding and precompile semantics unproved.

spans.label: point-evaluation exact response guards
spans.note: Call success/exact64-byte result/4096/modulus enforced before success.

spans.label: commitment SHA memory request
spans.note: Exact commitment SHA request retained; 48-byte copy/staticcall/mload realization open.

spans.label: SHA guard and versioned hash mask

spans.label: modexp memory and call

spans.label: modexp failure propagation

boundaries.name: kzg_and_ceremony
boundaries.obligation: KZG ceremony is accepted; precompile cryptographic soundness and its exact input semantics remain external obligations.

boundaries.name: blob_evaluation
boundaries.obligation: verifyConcrete/attestConcrete now instantiate verifyBlobBody with the forward/backward evaluation algorithm. EVM SimpleCoder memory correspondence, complete barycentric interpolation/inversion theorem and point-precompile cryptographic soundness remain open; typed observations are not those proofs.

boundaries.name: abi_and_preimage
boundaries.obligation: Typed domain records must equal Solidity ABI bytes; SHA/Keccak/precompile output decoding remains unproved.

boundaries.name: hash_binding
boundaries.obligation: Hash collision resistance, nonzero receipt digests and domain-preimage binding are needed for receipt authenticity; not required for the weaker executable storage lemmas.

boundaries.name: evm_and_finality
boundaries.obligation: BLOBHASH contiguity, staticcall/returndata/memory/gas, exact return tuple decoding, transaction rollback and real rollup context are not proved.
